description: This file defines the BuzzAnniversaryDao class, which interacts with the database to retrieve and count upcoming employee anniversaries based on specified search filters. It includes methods for building paginated queries using Doctrine QueryBuilder, focusing on employee anniversary date calculations, and filtering out terminated or purged employees.

classes.name: BuzzAnniversaryDao
classes.description: Data access object responsible for fetching employee anniversary data, including upcoming anniversaries and their counts, utilizing Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of upcoming employee anniversaries based on the provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Doctrine Paginator object with a query filtered for upcoming anniversaries, considering date ranges and employee status.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of upcoming employee anniversaries matching the filter criteria.
